en.title: Requiem of the End: The Migratory Bird's Anthem and the Afterglow of Dawn
en.premise: In a cursed world where "stardust" raining down from the heavens erodes people's memories and petrifies their minds, humanity strains its ears to hear the cries of sacred birds crossing the skies, desperate to anchor their fading recollections. One night, a "dawn radio broadcast" miraculously resounds from an old wireless set, playing a prophetic melody that threatens to destroy the world. A memory hunter and a boy searching for lost words step forth into a journey concerning the true nature of the world.

zh.title: 终焉的奏鸣曲（Requiem）：候鸟的圣歌与黎明的残光
zh.premise: 在这个从天界倾泻而下的“星尘”会侵蚀人类记忆、令精神石化的被诅咒世界里，人们为了维系失落的记忆，侧耳倾听着飞越苍穹的神圣鸟鸣。某天夜晚，一档“黎明广播”奇迹般地从陈旧的无线电设备中传出，流淌出了将毁灭世界的预言旋律。猎取记忆之人与寻找失落话语的少年，就此踏上了探寻世界真理的旅程。
